title: Stockfish engine state diagram
description: The one Engine the page bridge keeps (bridge/engine.ts): Stockfish in a Web Worker, started on first use. The game asks for one move at a time through chessBridge.bestMove, which calls back with the move, or with an empty string when the engine fails; a cancelled answer is not passed on. generation tells a current search from a cancelled one; stale counts bestmove answers still to come from searches stopped mid-way, which are thrown away. A cancelled search's promise is left unsettled.
machine: Engine (bridge/engine.ts): ready, waiting, generation and stale

states.description: The Worker from engine/stockfish.js was created and sent "uci"; waiting for "uciok".
The Worker couldn't be created or reported an error before "uciok": ready stays rejected, so every later bestMove rejects and the game gets an empty move.
Ready, and no answer awaited (waiting = null). A stopped search may still be finishing in the Worker.
Skill Level, position and go have been sent; waiting for bestmove.
bestmove arrived; waiting out the rest of the strength's minimum pause (450 ms at level 1 down to none at levels 7 and 8) before answering.

transitions.action: Reject ready with "The engine couldn't start."; a waiting bestMove rejects.

transitions.guard: a bestMove is waiting for start()
transitions.action: Resolve ready; generation++; post the commands for its level and moves.
generation++; set waiting; post setoption Skill Level, position startpos moves …, go depth or movetime.
stale--; ignore it: it answers a cancelled search.
generation++; waiting = null; stale++; post "stop". The call's promise never settles.
Resolve with X; the bridge calls the game back with it.
Reject with "cancelled"; the bridge doesn't call back.
